items.description: Weglore is a location based photo sharing app that allows users to explore the globe with map navigation and photo markers. The photo series incorporates smart social functions that enable filtering of unwanted photos and sharing photos pertaining to a similar subject. The Weglore mobile app users geolocation to add metadata to photos, and enables users to subscribe to photos aggregated to a particular location, with optional notification settings as well as other functions. The app is free and can be downloaded for Android from Google Play.

Flixster provides services for discovering, collecting, and watching movies and TV programs. Users can create a profile and store movie ratings, favorites, lists, and more. Users can connect their profile with friends, and discover, purchase and view a variety of content. The services offered from Flixster can be integrated with social media platforms and other applications.
An Automatically updating reddit technology subreddit. Can be played to stream or just left alone. Each dot represents 10 people. Nodes can be clicked to view topics.
Tell Goal Prompt what your goals are and how you plan to achieve them, and we'll call you up with gentle reminders to take that next step.
This site is a demo to show the functionality of the Shopping.com API version 3. Includes all local US,UK,DE,FR,AU.

Yaptap enables communities to communicate however they wish: by text, email, phone, or social media. Group leaders can use either a web or mobile (iPad) application to organize groups, events and communications while members use the tools they want (text or email).

Cash4Books has for years been enabling its customers to allocate a portion of the cash they receive for their books in support of classroom projects. By plugging into our API's transactional functionality, Cash4Books customers now receive a DonorsChoose.org gift card for the precise denomination of their donation and can hand-pick the classroom project themselves!
Web tool for cleaning your del.icio.us tags. It can detect and merge your duplicate tags automatically.
Google Maps mashup for those wanting to discover new restaurants in a specific area.
Lets you search for flights and see the current location plotted on a Google Map.
An Amazon AWS site. Has SMS feature, library lookups, bios, images, clips, sales rank tracking, reviews and more. Allows price comparison by SMS too.
Google map mashup with custom tiles of shaded relief. Nice integration with GeoNames database for place and feature-based searching.

thetrendbed.com displays and keeps record of the top trending news articles, twitter trends and trending youtube videos worldwide and in various countries. It is good for analysis of trends and trend histories.
MyGlobalLounge is a social mapping community to meet loungers in your vicinity and worldwide. Uses a map where you can look at several live-webcams and at the profiles of the loungers.
A quick and easy way to find movies, watch trailers and share with friends!
There are literally thousands of hotels across the world employing green policies of some kind, but these hotels truly represent the best of green culture.
Select any section of a webpage in Firefox and find related scientific and research papers. A resource for any scientist, literary writer or researcher in any field.
Trip planner that enables planning a perfect trip in under 15 minutes.
Google Maps mashup of the Detroit Tigers players and where they are from. Popups include photos and links to detailed stats.
Job search site that will plot job locations on a Google Map.
Selection of cheap boots for women and men from some top brands and stores. Search by Brand, type, size and even boots that are on sale. Easy to use interface and some very low prices on boots.

This unique road trip planner locates hundreds of points of interest along the trail pioneered by the Lewis and Clark Expedition. Find historic sites, national parks, state parks, campgrounds and much more. Great way to plan a family vacation!
Website with YouTube videos.
Phone Idol is a phone-based singing competition. Dial in and sing a song for the world to hear. Then American votes and one person will become the Phone Idol.
Map of the main players in Silicon Valley like Google, Yahoo, Facebook, eBay and many others. Via Valleywag.
Displays all Montreal subway statons and lines. Markers are placed very accurate. Can display lines separately.
Very good, up-to-date gas price search with Google Maps station display.
Cuevox is a meeting reminder service but with a twist. At the proper time, Cuevox will call your attendees and ask them if they would be on time or not. Cuevox then lets you know.
Keep Track of My Games aims to be a way for you to not only manage your collection of games, but also remind and track your upcoming games. Based on the Twilio and Twilio SMS APIs.
Search Flickr for geotagged photos and then plot them on a Google Map. Nice nested map-within-a-map.

Browsing photos on Facebook can be painfully hard. In Sharendipity, access your entire social graph in Facebook. This mashup gives you a way to view all photos, whether they are yours or your friends.
This mashup allows users to share files with their Ning networks using Box.net.
